name: Ribosome
oneLine: The machine that reads a gene’s message and builds a protein.
howItWorks: The ribosome grips an mRNA and reads three letters at a time. For each triplet, a matching tRNA brings an amino acid. The ribosome links them into a chain.
deeper: The working heart of the ribosome is RNA, not protein. That is strong evidence RNA came first. The 2009 Nobel Prize went for mapping its structure.
sizeComparison: a 4,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Real ribosomes have about 50 proteins and three RNAs; we show a simple two-part shape.
